request.system:
An earlier incident on another project may be relevant to a new issue.
Write one plain sentence (at most 30 words) saying why it is relevant and what happened last time, using only the facts given. No speculation.
Return JSON {"explanation": "..."}.
request.user:
New issue (Drumgarve, 2025-02-07): Transformer supplier lead time extension. Main transformer lead time has been revised from 38 weeks to 54 weeks, pushing delivery from September 2025 to January 2026.
Earlier incident (Netherwood, 2025-02-05): Contractor performance not shared between projects. The civils contractor's delay at Netherwood was not known to the Drumgarve team when they were appointed there. Outcome recorded: The civils contractor's delay at Netherwood was not known to the Drumgarve team when they were appointed there.

response.explanation: The Netherwood incident is relevant because the civils contractor's delay was not shared with Drumgarve, potentially affecting their transformer delivery timeline.
